headline: Pavol's rule (1 Nov) is live: every answer counts when given; an unfinished lesson waits on home with Pokračovat / Nový trénink and resumes at the first unanswered question; a mock exam left early keeps its answers and records no attempt.

shipped.title: feat(resume): an answer counts when given; unfinished lesson waits with Pokračovat
shipped.live_checked: 2026-11-01, https://zbrojnikviz.dravec.org at 390 px: left a lesson at 8 of 12, reloaded, home showed 'Rozpracovaná lekce · 8 / 12 zodpovězeno', Pokračovat opened 09 / 12 on the same 9th question

decisions.question: Which rounds can be resumed?
decisions.default_taken: lesson and cases; one slot for the lesson, one per case. The mock exam is not resumable (timed); leaving it keeps answers, records no attempt.
decisions.why: Cases are served in a fixed teaching order, so restarting one would re-serve exactly the answered questions, which the rule forbids. The exam's 40-minute timer makes resuming it a different exam.

decisions.question: Where does an unfinished case appear?
options: on its own row in Procvičovat › Případy
decisions.why: Pavol's rule puts the lesson on home; keeping the home screen to one primary card avoids clutter.

decisions.question: When is a round saved?
decisions.default_taken: after the first answer; leaving before any answer leaves nothing to resume
decisions.why: A 0 / 12 'Pokračovat' would be the same as a new lesson.

decisions.question: Does an unfinished lesson expire?
decisions.default_taken: never; the streak counts on the day it is finished
decisions.why: The streak already counts only finished lessons, so an old snapshot cannot inflate it; expiry would throw away a place the learner chose to keep.

decisions.question: Events for resume / replace
decisions.default_taken: start_lesson {resume:true}, start_lesson {replaced:true}, start_practice {kind:'case', resume:true}; lesson_complete unchanged and only on a finished lesson
decisions.why: No new names without a flywheel policy PR; props are enough to count resumes.

decisions.question: Rule 1 outside lessons: practice by okruh
options: never-answered questions first, then the rest
decisions.default_taken: never-answered first, then the rest (both shuffled)
decisions.why: Starting okruh practice again after leaving part-way otherwise re-serves answered questions. Weak drill, review and bookmarks re-ask by design and are unchanged.

decisions.question: Review share in a new lesson after leaving at 8
decisions.default_taken: keep the existing share; at most 4 of 12 may be among the answered 8
decisions.why: Pavol's rule explicitly allows the review share as a minority; changing spacing is a separate decision.

decisions.question: Account switch and two tabs
options: clear rounds on account switch; tabs adopt each other's rounds
decisions.default_taken: clear on switch; tabs adopt via the storage event
decisions.why: Rounds hold the previous account's answers; the independent review flagged both paths (non-blocking), fixed before merge.

next: Port the same rule to the other quiz trainers, adapted to each engine (the round snapshot in src/domain/round.ts is bank-agnostic apart from getQuestion).
After a week: share of start_lesson with resume:true, and lesson_complete rate of resumed vs fresh lessons.
